panels.title: Tips right now
panels.description: Number of findings in cc.tips. cc.tips always looks at the last 7 days and ignores the dashboard time range and the project / session / actor / skill variables.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS tips FROM cc.tips

panels.title: Tips by category
panels.description: Findings per category in cc.tips. Fixed 7-day window: the dashboard time range and variables do not apply.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, count() AS tips
FROM cc.tips
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY tips DESC, category

panels.title: Usage tips (click a title to open the related dashboard)
panels.description: Source: view cc.tips. It always covers the last 7 days and does NOT use the dashboard time range or the project / session / actor / skill variables. The title link opens one evidence panel full-screen (viewPanel) on the related dashboard, with the project / session / actor preset and the current time range. metric is the number behind the tip; its unit is in the unit column.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT category, title, body, scope, metric,
       multiIf(category = 'cache', '% cache hit', category = 'short-opus', 'USD', category IN ('slow-hook', 'slow-ttft'), 'ms mean', category = 'agent-outlier', 'tokens', 'count') AS unit,
       concat(link, if(position(link, '?') > 0, '&', '?'),
              if(startsWith(link, '/d/cc-sessions'), 'var-project=%24__all&', '')) AS open
FROM cc.tips
ORDER BY category, metric DESC

options.content:
**What a tip is.** A heuristic hint computed by the view `cc.tips` over the last 7 days. The window is fixed: the dashboard time range and the variables do not apply. A tip says a value crossed a threshold: it is worth a look and may be perfectly fine. The thresholds are first guesses.

| Category | Fires when (last 7 days) | What to look at / do | Link opens |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| cache | per project: at least 20 requests and cache hit rate below 40 % | keep the prompt prefix (CLAUDE.md, tools) stable; fewer /clear and model switches | Overview: Cache hit rate by project |
| repeated-read | per project and file: read more than 10 times | keep key facts in CLAUDE.md or a note instead of rereading | Tools & files: Files re-read within one session |
| big-results | per project: at least 5 tool results over 200 KB | narrow the search or limit the read range | Tools & files: Largest tool results |
| short-opus | per project: at least 20 Opus requests under 500 output tokens, and they are at least half of all Opus requests | a smaller model may handle such turns; the cost shown is the upper bound of the saving | Prompts: Most expensive prompts |
| agent-outlier | per subagent type: at least 3 runs, the biggest run over 6 times the mean and over 50k tokens | check what that run did | Sessions: Session timeline (session and actor preset) |
| denials | per project and tool: at least 5 rejected permission decisions | if the rule is intended, ignore; otherwise review the permission rules | Tools & files: Rejected tool calls |
| slow-hook | per hook: at least 10 runs and mean over 500 ms | hooks run synchronously and delay every matching tool call | Health: Hook time |
| slow-ttft | per project and model: at least 10 requests and mean time to first token over 3 s | long contexts or a busy provider | Health: Time to first token by day |

There is no rule for repeated Bash commands: the telemetry carries only the first word of a command.

There is no dismiss button: a tip disappears when the 7-day window no longer meets its rule.

The rules live in `clickhouse/views.sql` (view `cc.tips`). After editing them, recreate the views: `docker compose run --rm views-init`.
